owner_session_id.description: Session currently working this feature. Advisory, not a mutex: it lets a second session see the collision instead of discovering it in the git log. Cleared on release.

owner_heartbeat_ts.description: When the owner was last seen. A claim older than the staleness window is treated as abandoned, so a crashed session cannot own a feature permanently.

archreview.description: Phase 6a-prime outcome. SKIPPED_NO_PANE records that no reviewer pane resolved; it now BLOCKS Phase 7 - a headless `exec agy` review satisfies the gate. SKIPPED_OPERATOR_OVERRIDE is the deliberate operator escape when no reviewer exists at all; it closes the feature but surfaces as a warning. Neither is ever equivalent to READY_TO_MERGE, and both must surface in the Phase 7 report.

substrate.description: Dispatch environment for this run, written at Phase-5 start from `hmad-dispatch env` via `--set substrate=…`. OPTIONAL and additive: records written before the field existed have no such key and stay valid (`required` is unchanged), so this is not a version break. `h_mad_telemetry.py record` copies it onto the run row so a log states which environment a feature dispatched under.

codex_status.description: Availability of Codex, as the Phase-5 implementer AND as the audit gate's second surface. OPTIONAL and additive (not in `required`; absent means 'available'). Two consumers read it. (1) The TDD-gate hook: while a feature is in step5, a production write reaching the hook is Claude self-implementing, which is blocked when Codex is available. (2) The audit gate: 'unavailable'/'exhausted' routes the second surface to the doc-auditor teammate leg, which then GATES. Set to 'exhausted' or 'unavailable' to record — auditably — that Codex cannot author or audit, permitting Claude to write the fallback (still test-first) and a teammate to hold the second leg. One switch, both effects: 5b runs inside step5, so a declaration made to route a document audit is live for 5d/5e production authoring on the same feature. Flip it back to 'available' when Codex returns.
